title: New Song Spotlight
description: This week’s spotlight is Travis’ "Sing" — the first single from the Scottish band’s 2001 album The Invisible Band. Produced by Nigel Godrich, the track pairs an easy, buoyant groove with a simple invitation to loosen up and sing out; its famously playful video turns a formal dinner into a full-scale food fight. For a Djembe show, it brings warm audience connection, rhythmic lift, and a chorus built for smiling participation.
songListNote: The first single from Travis’ 2001 album The Invisible Band, with a buoyant indie-pop groove and a famously playful food-fight video.
